name: decko-ts
description: TypeScript port of the Decko card engine, validated against Ruby Decko (card 1.110.0 / decko 0.20.0) used as a rendering oracle. On the with-mods corpus replay of 2026-09-23, 167,674 of 180,442 captured views render byte-identically (92.9%); see the README's Migration status section for the run and what the remaining gap is. Edge-native (Cloudflare D1, Bunny/libSQL). Upstream proposal: decko-commons/decko#1282.

DB.description: Your deck. The deploy creates this D1 database for you and fills it with the core schema plus a small 4-card demo deck (`Home`, `Hello World`, `About`). Read-only in the demo — the Worker never writes to it.

scripts.db:migrations:apply: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.deploy: npm run db:migrations:apply && npx wrangler deploy
